verdicts.why: Iron Fist S1E12 ends with Ward warning Danny he has been set up; in S1E13 Ward allies with Danny, Colleen and Claire and shoots Harold on the roof. Ward bullied Danny as a child.

value.title: Iron Fist S1#13
value.text: Joy, betrayed by her father and brother, meets Davos and agrees with him that Danny must be removed.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Joy's partner against Danny, who says Danny must be removed.

split.title: Iron Fist S2#5
split.text: Joy helps Davos take the Iron Fist from Danny. Once Davos has the power and grows violent, she regrets the partnership and hires Mary Walker to protect her from him.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Davos's partner against Danny, who regrets it and hires protection.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Joy's partner against Danny, until he turns violent.

verdicts.why: The partnership starts in S1E13, where Joy meets Davos in Paris and agrees Danny must be removed, not S2E1. The regret and hiring of Walker (S2E5) are kept as a split instead of dropped.
S2E8 Joy undermines Davos and BB helps her steal the bowl; S2E9 Davos discovers it and pushes her off a balcony.

value.title: Luke Cage S1#1
value.text: Diamondback recruited Shades after prison and sends him to Harlem to deal with Cottonmouth's failed gun deal and keep watch over his operation.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Diamondback's recruit from prison, sent to watch Cottonmouth.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Shades's boss since prison, who sends him to Harlem.

split.title: Luke Cage S1#9
split.text: Arriving in Harlem himself, Diamondback mocks Shades for trying to take over Cottonmouth's operation and holds a gun to his head.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Diamondback's man in Harlem, whom he nearly shoots.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Shades's boss, who holds a gun to his head.

verdicts.why: Boss is wrong where S1E12 leaves them (see the added enemy stage), and the boss relationship starts in S1E1, where Shades arrives under Diamondback's orders, not S1E9. The S1E9 gun scene is kept as a split.
Soliloquy of Chaos (S1E12): Diamondback has Shades bailed out and orders Zip to kill him; Shades kills them and allies with Mariah against Diamondback.
The scene where Zip talks Diamondback out of shooting Shades and is called smarter than his name is in DWYCK (S1E9), when Zip's crew starts working for Diamondback.
DWYCK (S1E9): Diamondback kills the other bosses but spares Mariah, who persuades him to sell Judas bullets to the police; that is where they start working together.
S1E12: Shades approaches Mariah and they plan to get Luke on their side against Diamondback.

value.title: The Punisher S1#3
value.text: David Lieberman, known as Micro, tracks Frank down as a stranger. After a violent first meeting, the two agree to work together against those behind Cerberus.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Micro's new partner against Agent Orange.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A stranger who tracks Frank down, then a partner against Agent Orange.

split.title: The Punisher S1#12
split.text: Frank and Micro's partnership against Agent Orange has grown into a real friendship.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Micro's partner and real friend against Agent Orange.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A stranger who tracked Frank down, now a partner and real friend.

verdicts.why: Micro contacts Frank in S1E2 and Frank, after torturing him, agrees to work with him in S1E3, so the start is S1#3. At that point they are uneasy partners, not friends, so the friendship is split off at the original title.
Madani arrives by helicopter as Pilgrim hunts Frank in S2E3; Pilgrim tails her, she pulls her gun and he tells her to repent in S2E6 (Nakazat). The relationship starts properly at S2E6.

The Other Thing (S6E5): Davis is irritated by Enoch's complaining (Piper reminds Davis of the fuse box he broke); Enoch sides with Atarah, who orders Daisy, Davis and Piper killed before Daisy fights her off and frees them.
Davis is presumed killed by Aida in S4; that Deathlok found him and got him medical help is only revealed in The Real Deal (S5E12). A S4 stage would spoil his survival.
Tracking Mace's suit to Nome is S4E14, not S5. In S5 Davis pilots the Zephyr in the Principia search with Coulson (S5E13) and flies Coulson's Quinjet in the Battle of Chicago (S5E22).
The Honeymoon (S5E17): Hale shoots Deke, Piper leads the surgery with Mack; drugged, Deke says he wants to kiss Daisy, and Mack and Piper keep it from her.

In S5E17 May helps Coulson and Talbot to the Zephyr while Deke is shot helping Daisy; nothing has Deke carrying Talbot. In S5E20 Deke finds Talbot's gravitonium choice not so bad and flies out with the team to rescue him and Coulson.
S5E21: Talbot, now Graviton, boards the Zephyr and crushes Kim while Deke and Davis hide; Deke tells Mack of the betrayal and goes to free the others.
WandaVision E9: Hayward jumps into a Humvee to drive at Billy and Tommy and Darcy rams it with a food truck; she does not stop any shooting.
After the La Cucaracha horn gives them away, Paxton pulls Dave and Kurt from the van, but they escape when the battle at Pym Technologies distracts the police. They are not arrested.

value.title: Luke Cage S1#9
value.text: Domingo Colon, Cottonmouth's old rival, makes a deal with Mariah Dillard after Cottonmouth's death and gathers Harlem's crime bosses for her.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Makes a deal with Domingo after Cottonmouth's death.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Cottonmouth's old rival. Makes a deal with Mariah after Cottonmouth's death.

split.title: Luke Cage S1#12
split.text: Domingo Colon is killed in his own attempt on Diamondback's life.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Made a deal with Domingo after Cottonmouth's death.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Cottonmouth's old rival, who made a deal with Mariah and dies attacking Diamondback.

verdicts.why: The deal and the gathering of bosses are in DWYCK (S1E9), so the move is right, but Colon's S1E12 death should be kept as a split rather than dropped.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#5
value.text: Raina visits Edison Po in prison as a fellow member of the Centipede Project and asks him to contact the Clairvoyant.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Centipede recruiter who visits Po in prison.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Centipede partner Raina visits in prison.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#10
split.text: Raina gets Edison Po out of prison to help capture Phil Coulson. When she pushes for answers about the Clairvoyant, Po warns her that the last person who asked got a knife for it.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Centipede partner who breaks Po out of prison to capture Coulson.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Centipede partner Raina frees from prison. Warns her off asking about the Clairvoyant.

verdicts.why: The breakout, the knife warning and Coulson's capture are S1E10, but the Centipede partnership starts in S1E5, when Raina visits Po in prison for their mutual employer. Start moved to S1#5, with the S1E10 events split off.
A Sin to Err (S1E6): Thompson and Sousa interrupt Dottie as she pulls a switchblade on Peggy; she claims she found Peggy like that, Peggy is arrested and Dottie abandons her room.

value.title: Agent Carter S2#6
value.text: Peggy Carter breaks Dottie out of prison and forces her to work with Jarvis to get a Zero Matter sample from Whitney Frost at Chadwick's fundraiser.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A forced partner against Whitney Frost.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A forced partner against Whitney Frost.

split.title: Agent Carter S2#7
split.text: Once the mission falls apart, Dottie breaks out of the trunk of Jarvis's car and escapes.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A forced partner. Dottie escapes the trunk of his car.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A forced partner who escapes the trunk of Jarvis's car.

verdicts.why: The forced partnership starts in Life of the Party (S2E6), but Dottie's escape happens in S2E7, so the move is split.

value.title: Agent Carter S2#6
value.text: Dottie Underwood flirts with Jason Wilkes when Peggy Carter recruits her to steal a sample from Whitney Frost.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A scientist Dottie flirts with on a mission.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A flirtatious recruit on Peggy's mission.

split.title: Agent Carter S2#7
split.text: Under Frost's torture Dottie gives Wilkes up, and Frost uses the distraction to kidnap him.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A scientist Dottie flirts with on a mission, then gives up under torture.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A flirtatious recruit who gives Wilkes up to Frost under torture.

verdicts.why: Dottie flirts with Wilkes during the S2E6 briefing, but the torture and kidnapping are S2E7, so the move is split.

value.title: Agent Carter S2#6
value.text: Dottie Underwood is sent to take a Zero Matter sample from Whitney Frost, and is captured and handed over to her.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Dottie's target, who has her captured.
value.on_b_card_about_a: An assassin sent after Frost, who is captured for her.

split.title: Agent Carter S2#7
split.text: Frost tortures Dottie with her Zero Matter powers until she reveals that Peggy wants it to save Jason Wilkes.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Dottie's target. Captures and tortures her.
split.on_b_card_about_a: An assassin sent after Frost. Frost captures and tortures her.

verdicts.why: Dottie is sent after Frost and captured for her in S2E6, but Frost tortures her in S2E7, so the move is split.

value.title: Agent Carter S2#1
value.text: Jarvis and Peggy investigate Calvin Chadwick, the Isodyne owner running for the Senate. Jarvis poses as a studio executive to get his wife alone.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A Senate candidate Jarvis spies on with Peggy.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Poses as a studio executive to spy on Chadwick.

split.title: Agent Carter S2#4
split.text: Jarvis and Peggy tail Chadwick to his campaign office, where they spot that his driver is the man who attacked Peggy.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A Senate candidate Jarvis tails with Peggy.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Tails Chadwick from his campaign office with Peggy.

verdicts.why: The studio-executive ruse at Santa Anita is S2E1, but tailing Chadwick from his campaign office is S2E4, so the move is split.

value.title: Agent Carter S2#1
value.text: Edwin Jarvis poses as a studio boss to get close to Whitney Frost for Peggy's investigation.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Villain Jarvis gets close to by posing as a studio boss.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Peggy's ally, who poses as a studio boss to get close to Whitney.

split.title: Agent Carter S2#8
split.text: After Frost shoots his wife Ana, Jarvis seeks revenge and shoots Frost, but her Zero Matter saves her.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Villain who shoots Ana. Jarvis shoots her in revenge.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Peggy's ally, who shoots Whitney to avenge his wife.

verdicts.why: The studio-boss ruse is S2E1, but 'becomes her enemy' at the original S2E8 is Jarvis shooting Frost in revenge for Ana, so that part is kept as a split.

value.title: Agent Carter S2#3
value.text: Rufus Hunt, a hitman for the Council of Nine, attacks Peggy Carter at Howard Stark's estate, and Edwin Jarvis helps fight him off.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A masked attacker Jarvis fights off at Stark's estate.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Stark's butler, who fights Hunt off.

split.title: Agent Carter S2#4
split.text: Jarvis helps Peggy capture Hunt, the Arena Club's head of security, by posing as a police officer to flush him out of his house.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Arena Club security chief Jarvis fights off, then helps capture.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Stark's butler. Fights Hunt off, then helps Peggy capture him.

verdicts.why: Hunt attacks Peggy and Jarvis fights him in Better Angels (S2E3), but the capture is S2E4, so the move is split.
Thompson and Sousa haul Jarvis in during S1E3 while Dooley watches; Dooley later follows Jarvis and asks him about Finow (S1E5), and Jarvis explains the vest in Snafu (S1E7).
Jessica identifies Sallinger in AKA Sorry Face (S3E6); Costa searches his apartment and holds him, then lacks the evidence to keep him. Before that Costa was only chasing an unknown attacker.

No Strings (E1): the A.I.s keep Ultron captive and find he betrayed them to Paladin. Through E6 he traps them and sides with Jocasta; no source has him and E.D.I.T.H. hunting Jocasta together. E7 aired today and E8 has not aired, so this may need another check.

value.title: VisionQuest#1
value.text: E.D.I.T.H. lives in White Vision's mind with the other Stark A.I.s and becomes his close friend, helping him learn about humanity.
value.on_a_card_about_b: E.D.I.T.H.'s host and close friend. She helps him learn about humanity.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Close friend living in Vision's mind, teaching him about humanity.

split.title: VisionQuest#4
split.text: When the Butcherbird Killer possesses Vision, E.D.I.T.H. expels her from his mind. Her human form is revealed to be modeled on Edith Marks, a pilot who worked for Howard Stark.
split.on_a_card_about_b: E.D.I.T.H.'s host and close friend, whom she frees from the Butcherbird Killer.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Close friend living in Vision's mind as Edith Marks, who expels the Butcherbird Killer.

verdicts.why: From E1 E.D.I.T.H. is among the A.I.s helping Vision, so the start is right, but the Edith Marks origin is explained in E4 (Malware), where she also expels Jocasta from Vision. That part is kept as a split.
Karja heads security on the Orgoscope and shoots Drax there during the infiltration; the High Evolutionary's ship is a different place.
Melina turns on Dreykov, frees Alexei and Yelena and helps bring down the Red Room, so the film leaves them as enemies.
Vol. 2: Nebula comes to kill Gamora on Ego's planet, they reconcile, and she fights with Drax and the Guardians against Ego before leaving to hunt Thanos.

Aftershocks (S2E11): Bakshi and Bloom confirm with List that he did not order the hit, then have the other HYDRA leaders killed, leaving Bakshi, Bloom, List and Strucker. The 'miss Whitehall' exchange is S2E19.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#18
value.text: Now secretly working for Coulson's team, Bakshi meets Dr. List and hands Deathlok over to him as a sign of good faith.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A HYDRA colleague secretly working for S.H.I.E.L.D.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The HYDRA scientist Bakshi secretly betrays to Coulson's team.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#19
split.text: Bakshi travels with List to his Arctic base and secretly passes S.H.I.E.L.D. the information it needs to raid it.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A HYDRA colleague secretly working for S.H.I.E.L.D. Helps raid List's base.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The HYDRA scientist whose base Bakshi helps S.H.I.E.L.D. raid.

verdicts.why: The secret betrayal starts in S2E18, when Bakshi meets List and hands over Deathlok, but the trip to the Arctic base and the tip-off are S2E19, so the stage is split.
Joey questions the captured Yo-Yo in Spanish and later urges her to join the Secret Warriors in Bouncing Back (S3E11); the Secret Warriors teamwork is S3E17 (kept in the next item).
The Team (S3E17): Yo-Yo and Joey fight together to retake Zephyr One, Joey melting the guards' bullets while she ties them up.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#20
value.text: When Elena comes to the Playground and is asked to sign the Sokovia Accords, she shows off her speed by stealing the medals off General Talbot's uniform.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The general who wants Elena on the Accords. She steals his medals.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The speedster who steals the medals off Talbot's uniform.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#21
split.text: Yo-Yo helps trap Hive and free his hostages while Talbot helps Coulson stop Hive's warhead launch.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The general who helps stop Hive's warhead while Yo-Yo fights Hive.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The speedster who helps trap Hive while Talbot stops his warhead.

verdicts.why: The medal theft is S3E20 (Emancipation). Working with Talbot against Hive is S3E21, so it is kept as a split instead of dropped.
Ascension (S3E22): after a Primitive shoots Yo-Yo, Radcliffe, brought in by May in S3E21, suggests sealing the wound with a blowtorch, which Mack does. Radcliffe was never under Hive's control.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#6
value.text: In the future Lighthouse, Yo-Yo rescues Flint, a young Inhuman who is the only one in his Terrigenesis ceremony to gain powers, and guides him when his powers first appear.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Young Inhuman Yo-Yo rescues and befriends in the future.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Friend from the future who rescues Flint and guides him through his powers.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#8
split.text: Yo-Yo and Mack stay behind with Flint to help free the people of the Lighthouse, and as the revolt against Kasius begins she cuts out his metric implant.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Young Inhuman Yo-Yo stays behind with to help free the Lighthouse.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Friend from the future who stays to help and cuts out Flint's implant.

verdicts.why: Yo-Yo rescues Flint at his Terrigenesis in S5E6, so the start is right, but staying behind (S5E7) and the metric removal (S5E8) should be split off, not dropped.
Ruby slices off Yo-Yo's arms against Hale's orders during the Sleeper Mech ambush in S5E11; a S5#20 start comes after Hale's story ends.
S5E18: Ruby dies in Hale's arms after Yo-Yo cuts her throat with a chakram; Hale glares at Yo-Yo with hatred, then escapes.
Ruby cuts off Yo-Yo's arms with her chakram in S5E11; the kill comes in S5E18 and is split off as the next item.
S5E18: Yo-Yo kills Ruby with Ruby's own chakram for revenge as the Gravitonium overwhelms Ruby.
